rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides sandboxed Python code execution capabilities where AI agents can write and execute Python scripts that orchestrate multiple MCP tool operations. Features a DSpy-powered reasoning system that generates code to accomplish tasks, with configurable sandbox options for network access, environment variables, and file system permissions. Includes policy enforcement for code safety with character and line limits, allowlisted imports, timeout handling, and a local HTTP bridge that allows sandboxed code to securely call external MCP tools.
